messages:
Jordan: Quick note — API reference for POST /v1/generate has a couple of mismatches: the request examples use 'prompt' in some places, schema shows 'input', and the streaming section shows plain JSON-lines but our runtime emits named SSE events (chunk/done). Docs CI flagged it. Can someone sweep?

Priya: I can take this. My plan: align examples to 'input' (backend canonical), add an explicit "Streaming responses" subsection showing SSE event names, and add a one-line Compatibility blurb explaining 'prompt' -> 'input'.

Olivia: Heads-up: changing examples will need regenerated SDK snippets (python/js/java). I can run the snippet generator after the OpenAPI update and paste updated samples into examples/snippets.

Jordan: Thanks. Also add an explicit SSE curl+client example showing event names and final done event — customers keep parsing JSONL and missing the event framing.

Priya: Draft SSE snippet (will include in PR):
```
# curl SSE example
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\n  -d '{"input":"Describe a sunrise","stream":true}' \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# server sends lines like:
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Pink light spills"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" across the ridge"}
event: done
data: {"id":"resp_789","status":"complete"}
```

Olivia: When you update the OpenAPI, run 'make docs-validate' locally. I hit subtle jsonschema differences once because CI pins a validator version. I'll pin the generator to v0.9.2 before regenerating snippets.

Build-bot: docs CI failure logged: lint/docs -> api-reference/generate.md (schema mismatch). See job: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/4012

Priya: I'll open branch docs/generate-sse-clarify and submit a PR with: api-reference/generate.md (request schema + examples), examples/snippets/* (placeholders), and a short /docs/compatibility.md note listing prompt->input mapping.

Docs-bot: linked issue #2567 -> PR 6451 opened by Priya (label: docs:needs-review)

Jordan: Great — reviewers @olivia and @devrel. Please include a one-line changelog at the top of the page so users see the breaking field rename right away. I'll review after CI passes. :thumbsup:
